Markus "pronax" Wallstén (born June 24, 1991) is a retired Swedish professional Counter-Strike: Global Offensive and Counter-Strike player. He is best known for leading Fnatic from November 2013 to November 2015, during which the team was widely regarded as the best in the world, winning three Major championships and nine other S-Tier tournaments. In April 2016, pronax founded the esports organization GODSENT.

Trivia

[edit]
  • In-game leader-wise, despite previously playing in teams like H2k Gaming and ESC Gaming with other dedicated in-game leaders such as Richard "Xizt" Landström and Finn "karrigan" Andersen in the past, he has assumed control of this role each time. He was also the in-game leader of Team Sweden over Xizt during their tournament run at The World Championships 2015. The only team where he wasn't the in-game leader was in n!faculty, where Lukas "gla1ve" Rossander took the role.
